farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:bd5651a5-45.description: Hello. We're Stadium Goods. We are the world's premier sneaker and streetwear marketplace selling only the most sought-after footwear, apparel and other hard-to-find items on behalf of our sellers. We are driven by our principles and committed to providing the best consumer and consignment experience there is. In January 2019, Stadium Goods became part of the Farfetch family of companies, which will help guide our evolution as we usher in the next chapter of growth. THE ROLE We are looking for Associate to support our General Warehouse Operations. You will manage the rate of inbound and outbound merchandise. You will also execute the process of returned merchandise. You have proficient data entry skills and familiarity with spreadsheets. You will partner with the Warehouse Operations Manager and peers to meet our goals of increased efficiency, profitability and customer satisfaction.
responsibilities: You will receive merchandise coming into the building by vendors, customers, or other warehouses based on Stadium Goods customers receiving SLA expectations.
You will examine incoming shipments for Authenticity
You will enter quantity received against the purchase order in the computer system and print back order and inventory stock put away lists.
You will keep a clean and safe working environment and optimize space utilization.
You will follow quality service standards and comply with all Stadium Goods procedures, rules and regulations.
You will work with manager and other team members to ensure a successful product lifecycle from beginning to end.

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:bcfa8eea-.description: Job Title: Research Operations & AI Enablement Lead Location: London (3 days per week in the office) About Gen Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. And it’s flexible enough to give you the space to do your best work. jobgether-jobgether:lever:5b4120c8-ad7c-.title: Research Engineer (Reinforcement Learning)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:5b4120c8-ad7c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Research Engineer (Reinforcement Learning) based in United Kingdom. Join a small, senior engineering team building the next generation of voice- and text-driven AI agents. You’ll focus on post-training models to make agents more capable, reliable, and effective over long-running interactions. Your work will span environments, verifiers, synthetic data, training experiments, evaluations, and production deployment. You’ll tackle challenging problems such as persistent context, reliable tool use, and multi-turn agent behavior. The role combines hands-on research and engineering, with a strong emphasis on measurable improvements in model performance. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers in a remote, collaborative environment where technical craft and creativity are highly valued. Your contributions will directly shape AI systems operating at significant production scale. Build training environments, verifiers, and supporting infrastructure for post-training models. Own the synthetic data pipeline from data generation through quality assurance and validation. Run end-to-end training experiments, analyze results, and clearly identify the factors driving model improvements. Design and maintain evaluations that models must pass before production releases. Select and adapt suitable open-weight foundation models for specific agent and product requirements. Develop trained behaviors that perform consistently across both voice and text-based agents. Deploy trained models to production and continuously improve them based on real-world usage and feedback. Develop robust approaches to long-horizon interactions, accumulated context, and reliable tool use during live conversations. Requirements: Strong Python engineering skills and the ability to build reliable, production-quality systems. Demonstrated experience taking a machine learning model from raw data through experimentation and into production. A strong data-centric mindset, with attention to coverage, diversity, quality, and data leakage. The ability to anticipate reward exploitation and design robust rewards, verifiers, and evaluation mechanisms. Practical experience working with GPUs and a realistic understanding of their capabilities and limitations. Strong judgment around when model training is the right solution—and when a simpler approach is preferable. Ability to collaborate effectively within a remote, distributed, and highly autonomous team. Experience with post-training techniques such as fine-tuning, reward design, or reinforcement learning, including approaches such as GRPO, is highly desirable. Familiarity with RL and fine-tuning frameworks such as TRL, verl, OpenRLHF, or custom training loops is a plus. Experience with technologies such as vLLM or SGLang for fast rollouts and FSDP for multi-GPU training is advantageous. Experience training tool-using or multi-turn agents, as well as building execution sandboxes, verifiers, evaluation harnesses, or developer tooling, is valuable. Familiarity with open-weight model families such as Qwen or Llama and techniques such as LoRA is a plus. Benefits: Opportunity to make a significant impact on a fast-growing developer platform and help shape its future. Collaboration with a small, highly experienced team that values technical excellence, creativity, and ownership. Competitive salary and equity package. Health, dental, and vision benefits. Flexible vacation policy. Remote-friendly working environment with flexibility and autonomy. jobgether-jobgether:lever:74f61361-5bb6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Analyst – Data Sensitivity & VDI Migration based in Finland. This role offers the opportunity to shape how sensitive data is stored, accessed, and protected across a complex enterprise environment. You will assess data sensitivity, system usage, workflows, and storage practices across multiple business areas. A key focus will be identifying high-risk use cases and determining where VDI, stronger access controls, or other secure solutions can provide the best protection. You will translate detailed analysis into practical recommendations, business cases, and migration roadmaps. Working closely with Security, Technology, and business stakeholders, you will help align solutions with data protection and governance requirements. The role combines business analysis, data security, infrastructure, and stakeholder management in a highly collaborative environment. Your work will directly support stronger data protection, informed technology decisions, and sustainable security practices. Partner with business groups across the organization to inventory systems, tools, endpoints, and data usage patterns associated with physical device storage. Assess and classify data sensitivity across business units, systems, processes, and workflows, identifying areas of heightened security risk. Analyze data and process flows across systems, servers, networks, and endpoints to support risk assessments and migration planning. Identify critical systems and high-risk data storage practices that should be prioritized for migration to VDI or other secure data management solutions. Document current-state and proposed future-state data storage, access, and usage models. Evaluate viable solutions, including VDI, enhanced access controls, and other secure data management approaches, and recommend the most appropriate option for each use case. Develop business cases and recommendations for VDI migration, considering risk, cost, operational impact, and user adoption. Facilitate stakeholder interviews, workshops, and requirements-gathering sessions across departments. Collaborate with Security, Technology, and business teams to validate findings and ensure recommendations align with applicable data policies. Present analysis, findings, and recommendations clearly to technology leadership and other key stakeholders. Support the development of a migration roadmap, including dependencies, priorities, adoption, and change management considerations. Contribute to the design and documentation of privileged access management (PAM) processes and frameworks as part of broader data security initiatives. Support the development of auditing and compliance review processes covering data usage, access controls, and end-to-end data security. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related discipline. 5–7+ years of professional Business Analyst experience, ideally with a strong background in data governance, data classification or sensitivity assessments, secure data storage, or IT infrastructure and endpoint initiatives. Demonstrated experience working in complex, multi-platform, enterprise-level environments and analyzing systems usage and data flows across multiple business units. Familiarity with VDI concepts and platforms such as Citrix, VMware Horizon, or Azure Virtual Desktop, or a proven ability to quickly understand and work within new technical domains. Strong experience conducting stakeholder interviews, facilitating requirements-gathering sessions, and translating complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations. Ability to develop use cases, cost-benefit analyses, business cases, and executive-ready documentation. jobgether-jobgether:lever:a7bafbb6-7aab-.title: Sr. UI/UX Designer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:a7bafbb6-7aab-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. UI/UX Designer based in Belgium. This is a senior design role focused on creating intuitive, polished, and engaging digital experiences across web and mobile products. You’ll work at the intersection of creative design and technical execution, partnering closely with developers and creative teams. The role offers ownership from early concepts and user flows through high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes. You’ll bring strong visual design fundamentals while considering usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and how products are actually built. AI-powered design tools will be part of the workflow, helping you explore ideas and prototype quickly without compromising quality. You’ll have the opportunity to work on conventional and experimental digital experiences, with room to contribute creative ideas and new approaches. This is a fully remote position requiring strong communication, autonomy, attention to detail, and availability during AEST working hours. Design intuitive, high-quality user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile products, balancing usability, aesthetics, and technical feasibility. Translate briefs, business objectives, and product requirements into user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and polished digital experiences. Develop interactive prototypes in Figma that effectively communicate user behaviour, interactions, transitions, and overall product experience. Establish and maintain strong visual design systems, applying disciplined grids, spacing, typography, hierarchy, and responsive layouts. Use AI-powered design and creative tools to accelerate ideation, exploration, and rapid prototyping while maintaining a high standard of design quality. Collaborate closely with developers and technical teams throughout the design process to ensure accurate and practical implementation. Present design concepts and decisions clearly to colleagues, clients, and stakeholders, incorporating feedback while confidently explaining design rationale. Take ownership of projects from initial concept through final delivery, identifying problems and developing thoughtful, creative solutions. Help structure and organise design work, documentation, and workflows so projects progress efficiently across distributed teams. Contribute to experimental and innovative digital experiences, including immersive websites, animations, micro-interactions, and other emerging design approaches where relevant. Requirements: 5+ years of professional experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design, Digital Design, or a comparable senior design position. A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent UI/UX capabilities, visual design quality, and creative range, particularly across web experiences. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including interactive prototyping and the ability to communicate complex interactions effectively. Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, usability, information architecture and hierarchy, responsive design, and accessibility fundamentals. Excellent visual design skills, with a deliberate and consistent approach to grids, spacing, typography, composition, and layout. Proven experience collaborating closely with developers or other technical teams and understanding the practical considerations involved in implementation. Ability to take an idea from an initial concept or rough brief through user flows, design exploration, prototyping, and a polished final experience. Strong creative problem-solving skills, curiosity, and the ability to challenge conventional approaches when appropriate. Excellent written and verbal English, with confidence presenting designs and articulating the reasoning behind design decisions. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively within a fully remote environment. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus,

You will serve as a key point of contact for creators while ensuring campaigns remain organized, on-brand, and aligned with client objectives. Professional or advanced English proficiency, both written and conversational. matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:8ce0fec6-bba.title: Director, Equity Accounting
matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:8ce0fec6-bba.description: Know where you belong! Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire. When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week. Our Accounting team is seeking a Director, Equity Accounting to serve as the definitive leader for the end-to-end accounting, valuation, and forecasting of our global equity incentive plans. This is a high-impact, Dallas-based role where you will act as a strategic advisor to senior leadership, ensuring our complex equity structures are technically sound and compliant.
responsibilities: Strategic Financial Ownership: Lead the end-to-end accounting, valuation, and forecasting for all global equity incentive plans. You are the definitive subject matter expert for ASC 718 and ASC 260 and the primary architect of the equity-related financial statement disclosures.

Executive Advisory & Board Reporting: Partner closely with the SVP of Financial Reporting, Legal Counsel, and the People Team. You will prepare and present high-level analysis on plan availability, burn rates, and the financial impact of proposed equity structures.

Global Mobility & Tax Compliance: Serve as the internal authority on the complexities of a modern workforce. You will oversee the logic for state and international mobility, ensuring that cross-border tax withholding and reporting are technically sound and compliant with local jurisdictions.

Advanced Forecasting & Modeling: Own the "Equity Crystal Ball." You will develop sophisticated models to forecast SBC expense, diluted shares impact, and cash flow requirements under multiple "what-if" scenarios.

Audit & Control Leadership: Set the standard for SOX compliance within the equity function. You will lead the relationship with external auditors, defending technical positions on valuations, and award modifications.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as the bridge between Finance, People/HR, and Legal. You will be the Accounting voice at the table providing insights into the accounting impact of daily decisions.
Team Mentorship: Directly manage and develop a Manager-level professional, fostering a culture of technical excellence, career growth, and extreme attention to detail.
Other Areas: ESPP, Section 16 filings
